title: Fans seek year-round community and content across platforms
discussion_signal: The post describes fandom as an always-on social layer spanning multiple platforms, with community, creator content, and generative AI extending engagement between releases. It makes platform fragmentation and co-creation part of the cultural-consumption signal.
linked_research_question: How do fandom, creator connection, and AI-enabled continuity reorganize cultural consumption across fragmented platforms?
limits: Audience and platform engagement are selective
Fandom identity does not imply representative cultural participation
